title: Colbert’s ‘Late Show’ is ending. Here’s what’s in store for the final episodes
description: A decade of late-night history is closing out this week, with Stephen Colbert’s tenure as the host for The Late Show coming to an end on Thursday. Filmed in the Ed Sullivan Theater, The Late Show is CBS’s flagship late-night talk show, first airing in 1993 with David Letterman hosting. Colbert joined the show in 2015—following successful stints at The Daily Show and The Colbert Report on Comedy Central—with his political monologues during the first Trump administration helping grow his popularity, particularly among more liberal viewers. His vocal critique of Trump is also seen by many as precipitating the end of his hosting duties. CBS parent company Paramount announced last July that this season, which concludes May 21, would be the final season of The Late Show .
